category: currency exchange rate API (166 fiat currencies, 873 cryptocurrencies and 4 metals)

free_tier.stated: Developer plan, free, no card: 1,000 API calls a month with a daily refresh at 00:00 UTC, USD as the only base currency; no daily or hourly rate limit.
free_tier.notes: The free key returns latest rates and the symbol endpoints only; historical rates need a paid plan, from Starter at USD 9.99 a month for 15,000 calls. The supported-currencies, currency-symbols and historical-data-limits endpoints need no key. The monthly quota may be spent in one day. At the free limit one email goes out and the API stops serving until the next month.

egress.terms: not metered in bytes; the 1,000 calls a month bound what a free key can pull

interface_detail: GET https://api.currencyfreaks.com/v2.0/rates/latest?apikey=KEY; JSON, or XML with format=xml
chaining: Daily rates for 1,000+ currencies at 1,000 calls a month; one call returns all currencies, so a daily pull uses about 30.

limits.value: 1,000 API calls a month on the Developer plan
latest rates only on the free key; historical rates need a paid plan

limits_note: Rate: no daily or hourly limit on any plan. Bulk path: none on the free key; the time series and fluctuation endpoints need Professional at USD 99.99 a month, and the vendor blog shows a Python loop that writes the series to CSV.
binding_note: The monthly count of 1,000 is the only limit, so it binds; the quota may be spent in one day.

identity_cost.detail: Free sign-up with Google or GitHub, or an email; no card. The terms say to sign up with a real company or personal email, that disposable addresses and shared mailboxes are deleted, and that accounts made by automated methods are removed. The sign-up runs on the vendor's APIFreaks platform.

reliability_note: At the free limit the API stops serving until the next month; one email notice is sent at 100 percent.
confidence_note: Quota, refresh, history gate and sign-up fields are read from first-party pricing, docs, FAQ, llms.txt and terms pages. No key was created.
